basic_profile.bio: I’m a 32-year-old software developer from Atlanta, Georgia. I've been on Reddit for nearly a decade, mostly lurking and occasionally contributing to discussions. I have a keen interest in personality types and spend a lot of time on subreddits related to the Enneagram and psychology. In my downtime, I enjoy gaming on my old Xbox 360, and I’m always on the lookout for mods and hacks to keep the experience fresh. I’m currently single and enjoy the occasional hookup, but I tend to get nervous about meeting new people. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8-11 PM EST. My job allows for a flexible schedule, so sometimes I pop in during lunch hours too.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 10 years. My expertise in software development is both from formal education and extensive self-teaching through online resources. Additionally, I'm well-versed in the intricacies of personality typologies, having spent years studying them for personal growth and understanding social dynamics.
